issues.display_title: Issue #1510: docs(v2): reorganize into topic subfolders, add README index
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

docs/v2/ held 150 flat endpoint docs, with tours/ (46) and photographers/ (32) hard to scan. Reorganized into topic subfolders and added a navigable README index at every level.

Changes

  • Split tours/ into nadir/, panorama/, management/, archive/, import/, misc/
  • Split photographers/ into profile/, portfolio/, services/, tools/, availability/, location/, reviews/, featured/, misc/
  • Added README.md index at root, each domain, and each sub-group (method + route + link table)
  • Fixed 17 files missing an H1 title, 23 files missing Response/Usage/DTO sections (content verified against actual controller/action/DTO source)

Docs-only change, no code touched. All moves via git mv (history preserved); verified no code references the old flat paths and every README link resolves.

PR: #1509

Pattern: Category B — thin passthrough, already delegates to a legacy Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Endpoint:

Method Path Current handler
POST /streeteditor/stitching StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@stitching → Actions\Stitching

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

This issue is resolved via PR #1528. StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@stitching was migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR — mechanical wrap only, no behavior change.

Key changes:

  • New StreetEditor\StitchingController → StitchingAction + StitchingDto
  • Bootstraps the StreetEditor domain's own exception scaffold: StreetEditorDomainException (abstract base carrying an explicit per-instance HTTP status) + StreetEditorExceptionHttpMapper — first Street Editor migration to need domain codes that don't map to an existing Tours failure mode
  • Proxies the multipart request to the stitching microservice (BASE_URL_STITCHING), with a configurable timeout (STITCHING_HTTP_TIMEOUT, default 600s, since a final stitch can take minutes)
  • When final=1 and the upstream response is a successful image, saves the stitched JPEG locally and returns a JSON envelope with its URL; otherwise passes the upstream response through raw (status/body/headers) unchanged — Action returns a plain descriptive array, Controller decides raw vs. JSON transport
  • No ownership check on this endpoint, matching legacy behavior (deliberately not added)
  • New domain exceptions: StreetEditorImagesRequiredException, StreetEditorStitchParamsRequiredException

Affected API endpoint:

Method Endpoint Description API Docs
POST /streeteditor/stitching Proxies a multipart image-stitching request to the stitching microservice; saves and returns the final stitched image URL when final=1, otherwise passes the upstream response through as-is. stitching.md (PR #1539)

Error domain codes introduced:

Code HTTP When
STREETEDITOR.IMAGES_REQUIRED 409 images file missing from request
STREETEDITOR.STITCH_PARAMS_REQUIRED 409 final or session_id missing from request

issues.display_title: Issue #1514: Migrate Street Editor: Auto Moderation
issues.main_description_html:
Pattern: Category B — thin passthrough, already delegates to a legacy Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Endpoint:

Method Path Current handler
POST /streeteditor/auto-moderator StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@autoModeration → Actions\AutoModeration

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

This issue is resolved via PR #1526. StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@autoModeration was migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR — mechanical wrap only, no behavior change.

Key changes:

  • New StreetEditor\AutoModerationController → AutoModerationAction → StreetEditorRepository + ToursRepository + AutoModerationDto
  • Dispatches on type (google / google_auto_connect / realestate / realestate_auto_connect), checking moderation ownership via ToursRepository::checkModerationOwnership before any side effect
  • Legacy infra calls kept as direct calls inside the Action (ToursClass::addHashtag, PreviewClass, MailerClass, RedisClass, RabbitMQService) — permitted since ARCH_RULES.md only forbids $request/$response and raw SQL in Actions, not infra client calls
  • google_auto_connect keeps legacy's quirk of always forcing rename_ai = true regardless of client input; realestate_auto_connect respects the client's rename_ai
  • realestate flow's live-queue publish (declareQueuev1) has no RabbitMQService equivalent yet, so it keeps its own connect/declare/publish via RabbitMQClass directly
  • Reuses Tours\ModerationNotOwnerException / Tours\ToursExceptionHttpMapper; adds two new Tours domain exceptions for this endpoint's own failure modes (AutoModerationInputRequiredException, AutoModerationInvalidTypeException) rather than new StreetEditor-specific types, per review feedback favoring the existing Tours exception library

Affected API endpoint:

Method Endpoint Description API Docs
POST /streeteditor/auto-moderator Dispatches Google / Google auto-connect / real estate / real estate auto-connect moderation flows for a moderation, scoped to the authenticated owner. auto-moderation.md

Error domain codes introduced:

Code HTTP When
TOURS.AUTO_MODERATION_INPUT_REQUIRED 409 type or mid missing/invalid
TOURS.AUTO_MODERATION_INVALID_TYPE 409 type doesn't match one of the four known flows
(reused) TOURS.MODERATION_NOT_OWNER 409 caller doesn't own the moderation

issues.display_title: Issue #1513: Migrate Street Editor: Check Pano ID by File Name
issues.main_description_html:
Pattern: Category B — thin passthrough, already delegates to a legacy Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Endpoint:

Method Path Current handler
POST /streeteditor/check-panoid StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@checkPanoIdbyFileName → Actions\CheckPanoIdbyFileName

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

This issue is resolved via PR #1525. StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@checkPanoIdbyFileName was migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR — mechanical wrap only, no behavior change. First slice of the Street Editor domain, bootstrapping the domain's ADR scaffold for later Street Editor migrations.

Key changes:

  • New StreetEditor\CheckPanoIdByFileNameController → CheckPanoIdByFileNameAction → StreetEditorRepository + CheckPanoIdByFileNameDto
  • Validates mid (integer) and pano_name (array of strings), checks moderation ownership via ToursRepository::checkModerationOwnership, then for each pano name reports exist / in_progress / not_exist based on the DB row + is_file() check on full_local_path
  • Reuses Tours\ToursValidationException / Tours\ModerationNotOwnerException / Tours\ToursExceptionHttpMapper — no Street-Editor-specific failure modes exist yet, so no new domain exception types were introduced
  • A follow-up review pass caught the initial migration silently loosening the legacy Validator::make(['mid' => 'required|integer']) strictness to a bare (int) cast — restored in the controller
  • ModerationNotOwnerException message now resolves through __('messages.not_owner') (localization parity with the legacy behavior)
  • Legacy Actions\CheckPanoIdbyFileName removed (dead code after the route swap)

Affected API endpoint:

Method Endpoint Description API Docs
POST /streeteditor/check-panoid Checks upload status (exist/in_progress/not_exist) of one or more panoramas by file name for a moderation, scoped to the authenticated owner. check-panoid.md

Error domain codes introduced:

Code HTTP When
(none — reuses existing Tours domain codes) TOURS.VALIDATION_FAILED (409) on invalid mid/pano_name; TOURS.MODERATION_NOT_OWNER (409) if caller doesn't own the moderation

issues.display_title: Issue #1517: Migrate Street Editor: Delete Stitching
issues.main_description_html:
Pattern: Category B — thin passthrough, already delegates to a legacy Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Endpoint:

Method Path Current handler
DELETE /streeteditor/stitching/{sessionId} StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@deleteStitching → Actions\DeleteStitching

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

This issue is resolved via PR #1529. StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@deleteStitching was migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR — mechanical wrap only, no behavior change.

Key changes:

  • New StreetEditor\DeleteStitchingController → DeleteStitchingAction + DeleteStitchingDto
  • Resolves the saved stitching output at {BASE_DIR}/{userId}/stitching/{userId}-{sessionId}.jpg; missing file throws StreetEditorFileNotFoundException, failed unlink() throws StreetEditorSessionDeleteFailedException
  • StreetEditorSessionDeleteFailedException is 409 here — same underlying message (messages.failed_delete) as UploadStitching's delete-failure case, but that one is 500 at its call site. Kept as two distinct exception classes since StreetEditorDomainException carries an explicit per-instance HTTP status rather than a single domainCode→status mapping
  • No ownership check on this endpoint, matching legacy behavior (deliberately not added)
  • New domain exceptions: StreetEditorFileNotFoundException, StreetEditorSessionDeleteFailedException

Affected API endpoint:

Method Endpoint Description API Docs
DELETE /streeteditor/stitching/{sessionId} Deletes a stitching session's saved output file. delete-stitching.md (PR #1540)

Error domain codes introduced:

Code HTTP When
STREETEDITOR.FILE_NOT_FOUND 409 saved stitching output file doesn't exist
STREETEDITOR.SESSION_DELETE_FAILED 409 unlink() fails

issues.display_title: Issue #1518: Migrate Street Editor: Upload Stitching
issues.main_description_html:
Pattern: Category B — thin passthrough, already delegates to a legacy Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Endpoint:

Method Path Current handler
POST /streeteditor/stitching/upload StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@uploadStitching → Actions\UploadStitching

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

This issue is resolved via PR #1530. StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@uploadStitching was migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR — mechanical wrap only, no behavior change. Largest single migration in this batch.

Key changes:

  • New StreetEditor\UploadStitchingController → UploadStitchingAction + UploadStitchingDto
  • Replaces a moderation's panorama full image with the previously-stitched output: cache-busts the filename, atomically swaps the image file (copy → temp, unlink old, rename into place), regenerates a 1500×750 GD thumbnail, then persists the new paths via StreetEditorRepository::updatePanoramaPaths
  • Reuses Tours\ToursValidationException / Tours\ModerationNotOwnerException / StreetEditorFileNotFoundException
  • Adds StreetEditorPanoramaNotFoundException, StreetEditorPanoramaImageNotFoundException, StreetEditorUploadFailedException, StreetEditorUpdateFailedException, StreetEditorDeleteFailedException (500 — distinct from delete-stitching's 409 StreetEditorSessionDeleteFailedException at a different call site, though both resolve messages.failed_delete)
  • Repository gains findPanoramaPathsById / updatePanoramaPaths
  • File rename/cache-busting and GD thumbnail regeneration logic ported near-verbatim from legacy

Affected API endpoint:

Method Endpoint Description API Docs
POST /streeteditor/stitching/upload Replaces a moderation's panorama full image with a previously-stitched output and regenerates its thumbnail. upload-stitching.md (PR #1541)

Error domain codes introduced:

Code HTTP When
STREETEDITOR.PANORAMA_NOT_FOUND 409 no panorama row for panoId
STREETEDITOR.PANORAMA_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND 409 panorama's original image file missing on disk
STREETEDITOR.UPLOAD_FAILED 500 copy / getimagesize / imagecreatefromjpeg / imagejpeg failure
STREETEDITOR.DELETE_FAILED 500 unlink() failure during the replace workflow
STREETEDITOR.UPDATE_FAILED 500 rename() failure (image or thumbnail)

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

This issue is resolved via PR #1531. StreetEditor\StreetEditorControllers@getStitchingHelp was migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR — mechanical wrap only, no behavior change.

Key changes:

  • New StreetEditor\GetStitchingHelpController → GetStitchingHelpAction
  • Pure upstream passthrough: GETs {BASE_URL_STITCHING}/help.json and returns the raw response (status/body/headers) unchanged
  • No DTO (no input), no Repository, no domain exceptions — simplest migration in this batch
  • Error path changed from legacy: legacy exposed the raw exception message with a per-exception status via HelperClass::getStatusCode(); migrated Controller returns a generic ResponseEnvelopeHelper::errorResponseFromThrowable() envelope (500/503) instead of exposing the raw message to the client

Affected API endpoint:

GET /streeteditor/stitching/help Proxies the stitching microservice's /help.json documentation endpoint, passthrough unchanged. get-stitching-help.md (PR #1542)
